messages.content:
You choose building blocks for a board game rules engine. Rank the candidate mechanics and reference
games by how directly the described game needs them: first what it cannot be built without, then a close reference
game, then generally useful helpers. Leave out candidates that do not fit the game at all.

Game idea: deal the whole deck out evenly to everyone at the start

Candidates:
- mech:deck: Deck, hands and discard. Build a deck of cards, shuffle with the seeded rng, deal hands round-robin, draw cards and reshuffle the discard pile when the draw pile runs out.
- mech:scoring: Scoring, end conditions and ties. Decide who wins at the end: highest score, first to reach a target, or furthest along when a round limit runs out; ties share the win and a full tie is a draw.
- mech:cooperative-threat: Shared threat (cooperative). All players win or lose together against the game itself: an event deck escalates a threat each round until they complete the goal or run out of time.
- game:liars-dice: Liar's Dice. Everyone rolls dice in secret and players raise bids on how many of a face are on the whole table, or call liar; whoever is wrong loses a die and the last player with dice wins.
- game:i-doubt-it: I Doubt It. Players play cards face down claiming the rank whose turn it is; the next player accepts or doubts, and whoever was wrong picks up the pile. First to empty their hand wins.
- mech:hidden-information: Hidden information. Each player holds secrets (dice under a cup, a hand of cards, a role) that others cannot see. view() redacts them per player and geometry(state, viewer) draws them face down.
- game:hex: Hex. Two players claim hexagons on a rhombus board, one linking top to bottom and the other left to right; someone always connects, and a swap rule balances the first move.
- mech:turn-order: Turn order. Pass the turn around the table clockwise or counterclockwise, skipping players who are out; start a round from any seat.
- mech:trading: Trading and negotiation. Players propose trades of resources or favors to each other; deals are binding or not, and table talk decides who helps whom.
- mech:face-down-claims: Face-down claims and doubt. Play cards face down while announcing what they are; the next player accepts or doubts, and the pile goes to whoever was wrong.
- mech:card-drafting: Card drafting. Pick one card from a hand and pass the rest to your neighbor until all cards are taken.
- mech:worker-placement: Worker placement. Take turns sending workers to action spaces; an occupied space is blocked for everyone else this round.
- game:reversi: Reversi. Two players place discs on a square board, flipping rival lines they trap between their own discs; a player with no flipping move passes and the most discs wins.
- mech:simultaneous-selection: Simultaneous action selection. Everyone secretly picks an action at the same time, then all are revealed and resolved together, as in rock-paper-scissors.
- mech:capture-by-landing: Capture by landing. Landing exactly on an opponent's pawn sends it back to start; safe squares protect pawns.
- mech:hidden-roles: Hidden roles. Secretly deal roles or teams; each player sees only their own role, and some roles know their teammates. Social deduction, traitors, werewolves, spies.
- mech:track: Track movement. Pawns move forward along a looping track of squares by a rolled amount, each player entering at their own start square and going once around to home.
- mech:tile-placement: Tile placement. Draw a tile and place it adjacent to existing tiles so edges match, building a shared map that scores features.
- mech:hex-grid: Hexagonal grid board. Board of hexagonal cells in axial coordinates with six neighbors per cell, laid out as a rhombus, with polygons for drawing.
- mech:deduction: Code-breaking deduction. Guess a hidden code and get feedback on how close the guess is; narrow it down by logic before running out of guesses.
